meaning.en: Third-person singular simple present indicative form of create.
meaning.vi: Ngôi thứ ba số ít thì hiện tại đơn giản dạng biểu thị tạo.

meaning_vi: tạo, tạo nên, tạo ra, tạo thành, sáng tạo
(từ lóng) làm rối lên, làn nhắng lên; hối hả chạy ngược chạy xuôi

sentences.en: It creates an obligation for me that I must honor.

sentences.en: This creates a short sound in the telephone.

sentences.en: He creates the parasites that are vamps, which then kill humans.

sentences.en: She creates premium services on her site that cost just $9.95 a year that include a number of additional features and virtual goods.

sentences.en: The act, while a most important landmark in the constitutional history of England, in no sense creates any right to personal freedom, but is essentially a procedure act for improving the legal mechanism by means of which that acknowledged right maybe enforced.

sentences.en: Similarly and conversely, when the wing ascends, it creates an upward current, which, being met by the wing when it descends, powerfully contributes to the efficiency of the down stroke.

sentences.en: If a councillor is elected he vacates his office of councillor, and thus creates a casual vacancy in the council.

sentences.en: In ancient classic poetry the measure which creates the metrical form consists only of this last quantitative element, which is rhythm.

sentences.en: It creates a sort of obligation, he said mockingly.
